findings.message: Source watcher effects access localStorage (saveToLocalStorage); normal-flow matching does not prove storage-failure propagation or continuation policy. Automatic watcher rewriting requires review.

Source watched-object writes have unproven key/shape or deletion semantics (updateSettings:settings); cloning and same-value guards do not prove new, undefined, inherited or prototype-key semantics. Automatic watcher rewriting requires review.
Default-async source root deep watchers must register before startup, coalesce in declaration order, read latest state and cancel pending work on disposal.
